description: .env file linter — Offline lint of a .env file: syntax errors (missing =, invalid names, unclosed quotes, spaces around =, unquoted spaces), duplicate keys, ${VAR} references to undefined variables, real credentials committed (Stripe/AWS/GitHub/Slack/OpenAI/Google keys, PEM private keys, passwords in connection strings - masked), short or placeholder secrets, DEBUG on, TLS verification off. Optional example= (or example_url=) compares against .env.example: missing keys, undocumented extras, real secrets in the example. Values are never returned. Pass text= or url=. Verdict OK/REVIEW/FIX/DO NOT COMMIT. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_env_check
